validity.researcher_notes: P5114 is a real, operating expansion phase of the LEAP gathering system. Confirmed as Expansion Phase 1 (the first phase of incremental compression/looping capacity added to the mainline gathering system). DT Midstream is the sole operator/owner. Project is correctly classified as natural gas transmission/gathering. Located in Louisiana, serving Haynesville shale takeaway to Gillis Hub and Gulf Coast interconnects (Sabine Pass, Cameron, Plaquemines, other LNG terminals). LengthKnown=0 is correct: this is a compression expansion with no new physical pipeline—confirms scope via EIA data. Not a duplicate: distinct from P5113 (mainline, 150 mi), P6773 (Phase 2, 400 MMcf/d), and P6842 (Phase 3, 200 MMcf/d). Operating since August 2023 per EIA and operator disclosure. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.
